about: Known-pair overrides for the hybrid path (ALGORITHM.md section 6). Donors are written as roles ('sire', 'dam') or animal ids. Only the listed traits are fixed; the rest come from the default hybrid operators. 'locked' overrides come from a hard card: evolution and edits may not change their fixed fields.
about_prompt: E2c: each pair's 'prompt' block drives the real-hybrid render prompt. 'cross' defaults to '<sire> sire x <dam> dam'; 'frame' is written in host terms ({host} is the frame donor's name); 'donor_features' are named once, after "with the <donor>'s"; 'aliases' are other names the critic may use for the hybrid itself.

pairs.name: mule
pairs.silhouette: horse-height equine frame with the horse's neck and body, a short thick donkey head with long ears, a short upright mane, thin limbs on small hooves

prompt.frame: horse-sized body, deep chest, long back, long neck, horse proportions

tail.note: tail short-haired at the base and longer below

coat_pattern.note: plain coat, no stripes or spots (none documented for mules, RC-R2-03)

pairs.name: hinny
pairs.silhouette: equine frame close to a mule but smaller and more horse-like, shorter horse-shaped ears, fuller mane and tail

prompt.frame: equine body a little smaller than a mule's and more horse-like, horse proportions, shorter horse-shaped ears, fuller mane and tail

coat_pattern.note: plain coat, no stripes or spots (none documented for hinnies, RC-R2-04)

processes: reciprocal cross differs from the mule
caveats: A hinny and a mule cannot reliably be told apart by looks alone.

pairs.name: liger

size.note: documented direction-specific growth beyond both parents

pairs.silhouette: very large cat frame, longer and heavier than either parent, long body, heavy forequarters, small or no mane

prompt.frame: very large cat body, longer and heavier than either parent, long back, heavy forequarters, tawny lion-like coat, small or no mane, lion proportions

processes: in-between blend as in real hybrids
diluted pattern from a non-body donor
growth beyond both parents in one cross direction

pairs.name: tigon
pairs.silhouette: large cat frame near parent size, long body, tawny coat with faint stripes, small or no mane

prompt.frame: large cat body near parent size, long back, tawny coat, small or no mane

processes: in-between blend as in real hybrids
diluted pattern from a non-body donor

pairs.name: zebroid
pairs.silhouette: equine frame with the non-zebra parent's body and base color, partial stripes on legs, neck and body

prompt.frame: {host}-sized body, {host} proportions and the {host}'s base coat color

coat_color.note: base color of the non-zebra parent

coat_pattern.note: partial stripes, strongest on the legs

processes: partial pattern from a non-body donor

pairs.name: polar bear and grizzly hybrid
pairs.silhouette: large bear frame with a long polar-like neck, a small grizzly-like shoulder hump and a visible tail

prompt.frame: large bear body with a long polar-bear-like neck, a small grizzly-like shoulder hump, a visible tail and a mostly pale coat

body.note: long polar-like neck, small grizzly-like shoulder hump

processes: in-between blend as in real hybrids

pairs.name: cama
pairs.silhouette: intermediate camelid frame with no hump, short camel-like ears and a long camel-like tail

prompt.frame: intermediate camelid body with no hump, short camel-like ears, a long camel-like tail and split two-toed feet

processes: intermediate look from distant but compatible parents
